name: Selin
self_text: Hi! I'm Selin, a non-binary Australian in my late 30s with a background in biology. Outside of my studies, I love podcasting because it lets me explore new stories. Right now, I'm focusing on programming. I find that I get the most out of studying independently side by side, and I do best with occasional short exchanges. I'm looking for someone to explain things to me during our sessions. I'm happy to meet in person, and most weeks I can do weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into studying independently side by side. It would be nice if you are available weekday evenings. Additionally, it's a small bonus if you are okay with complete silence while working or occasional short exchanges, but no big deal.
